items.html: And the Yesod is male, and is not from the side of Bina, for she is female; therefore her spreading is not within it, but only until Hod; and Hod was given to Moshe, as is stated in the Tikkunim, and in the Ra'aya Mehemna. Nevertheless, the upper point of Tzion, which is in Bina, is within it, although it is not recognizable; and there is found in it revealed male power and hidden female power. And in this aspect the Yesod is called Tzion in many places.
